description.zh:
结束时间。

格式为Unix时间戳，即从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.
The ID of the application group.

description.zh:
搜索事件内容包含的关键字。

- 如果您待搜索事件的内容中包括A和B，则可以搜索A和B。
- 如果您待搜索事件的内容中包括A或B，则可以搜索A或B。
description.en:
The keywords that are used to search for the event.

- If you need to query the custom event whose content contains a and b, set the value to a and b.

- If you need to query the custom event whose content contains a or b, set the value to a or b.

description.zh:
开始时间。

格式为Unix时间戳，即从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

title.zh: 查询自定义事件的统计结果

descriptions.zh: >此API以产品为维度统计每个产品自定义事件的数量。
descriptions.en: > This operation queries the number of times that a custom event occurred for each service.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-custom-event-count --name BABEL_BUY --event-id 123 --group-id 12345 --search-keywords cms --start-time 1552209685596 --end-time 1552220485596 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeCustomEventCount --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime 1552220485596 --StartTime 1552209685596 --EventId 123 --SearchKeywords cms --Name BABEL_BUY --GroupId 12345
